our customers gets free goods. This may be your (2)________ day!’

and say “Madam, this is your lucky day. (4)________ in your basket is free.”

to the cash desk when the manager of the supermarket come up to her and said. “You are our
lucky customer and everything in your basket is (5)________ !”
